entities.title: The same reign in every browser and on the server
entities.summary: The engine must give the same reign from the same seed and keys, wherever it runs.
entities.requirement: Engine code draws random numbers only through its own seeded generator (draw and pick in state.ts), in the order RULES §15.4 gives, and uses no timers, DOM or Math.random once a reign has its seed, so the Worker replays a reign exactly as the browser played it.
entities.measuredBy: test/flow.test.ts, "the same seed and keys replay the same reign"; test/scores.test.ts, "a replay from the seed and the keys gives the same score"; test/rng.test.ts, the generator and the draw order.

origin.description: The repository's agent instructions: the games' engines must stay deterministic.

entities.title: Every reign ends
entities.summary: Whatever keys are pressed, a reign reaches its final report without an error.
entities.requirement: For any sequence of keys, including keys no prompt expects, a reign ends with the final report, and the state stays within its bounds at every screen (groups 0–9; costs, bodyguard and Swiss account never negative).
entities.measuredBy: test/bot.test.ts: six key policies × 1,000 seeds, invariants checked at every screen.

sources.symbol: bots play 6,000 full reigns without errors, and every reign ends with the final report

entities.title: Everything from this origin
entities.summary: The page loads nothing from elsewhere except Cloudflare Web Analytics.
entities.requirement: The page's content security policy allows scripts, styles, images and connections only from its own origin, plus Cloudflare's analytics beacon and its reports; no framing, forms, plugins or base URL changes. The scores page has its own, stricter policy with inline styles only.
entities.measuredBy: public/_headers, served by Cloudflare's static assets; worker/look.ts, sitePage, for the scores page.

entities.title: Flashing stays slow and small
entities.summary: FLASH swaps every 0.32 s, and a screen flashes at most a small area.
entities.requirement: Flashing stays under 3 Hz: FLASH swaps ink and paper every 320 ms, as on the Spectrum. A screen drawn in full flashes only its cursor; while a held screen waits out its time it flashes only the alarm lamp or the rifle sight.
entities.measuredBy: test/layout.test.ts, "every screen, drawn in full, has the footer, and its cursor is the only flash" and "while a held screen waits out its time, it flashes only the alarm lamp or the rifle sight, and nothing in the footer rows".

entities.title: Touch targets of at least 44 pixels
entities.summary: Every keypad button and the sound button is at least 44 × 44 CSS pixels.
entities.requirement: Keypad buttons and the sound button are at least 44 CSS pixels wide and tall.
entities.measuredBy: public/zx.css (min-width and min-height of #keypad button and #sound); checked by hand in the browser (docs/TEST-PLAN.md row 13).

origin.description: GDD §10: touch targets are at least 44 × 44 CSS pixels.
